title: Dispatch: live-curse-state doff gate fix (attempt 1)
description:
Works defect bead eshyra-gacz (read it first: full analysis with file/line refs). Parent spec: eshyra-geny (acceptance criterion 1).

Branch/worktree: this bead's id, cut from eshyra-geny.

## Code survey (verified 2026-07-19)

- `packages/core/src/state/attunement.ts:141` `assertInventoryCurseCustodyReady` — the defective gate: at lines ~205-214 it throws for `curse.blocksDoff === true` whenever the item is worn (or wear ambiguous), never consulting live condition state.
- `packages/core/src/state/inventoryWear.ts` — don attaches the curse condition: `findDonCurseState` (line 149) finds the `stateDefinitions` entry whose `onset` is `'don the armor'` or starts with `'don '`, and `addCondition` attaches it. Doff calls the gate with mutation `'doff'`.
- Conditions live in `character.conditions_json` (JSON array of entries with `id`). `removeCondition` in `domainMutations.ts:154` removes them freely.
- Import-cycle caveat: `domainMutations.ts` imports from `attunement.ts`, so `attunement.ts` must NOT import `readConditions`/anything from `domainMutations.ts`. Read `conditions_json` with a local SQL query + minimal parse instead, or put a shared helper in a leaf module both can import.
- Pack data: `magic-item:demon-armor` has `curse.blocksDoff: true` and state `m7-demon-armor-curse` with don onset — usable in tests via the bundled SRD pack.

## Required behavior change

In `assertInventoryCurseCustodyReady`, when `curse.blocksDoff === true` and the item is worn by its holder with unambiguous wear state:

- Determine the applicable don-onset curse state id from `curse.stateDefinitions` (same onset predicate as `findDonCurseState` — extract/share that predicate rather than duplicating it).
- If such a state id exists and the holder's `conditions_json` does NOT currently contain that condition id → the curse has been resolved: do NOT throw for blocksDoff (fall through to the rest of the gate).
- If the state id exists and the condition is present → keep throwing (current message fine).
- If the curse declares no don-onset state definition → keep the current fail-closed behavior (no live signal to consult).
- Ambiguous wear state (no wear row / wrong character) → keep failing closed exactly as today.
- Malformed/unparseable `conditions_json` → fail closed with a MagicItemCustodyError (never silently allow).

Re-donning after curse removal correctly re-attaches the condition via the existing don path — do not change that.

## Tests (packages/core/test/inventoryWear.test.ts, follow existing patterns there)

Sequence test: don Demon Armor → doff fails (blocksDoff) → removeCondition('m7-demon-armor-curse') → doff succeeds → item remains held by character with wear_state 'not_worn'. Plus: doff still fails when condition present; still fails closed when curse has blocksDoff but no don-onset state definition (synthetic record or targeted unit of the gate helper); ambiguous-wear fail-closed behavior unchanged (existing tests must keep passing unmodified).

## Verification

`npm run verify:worktree` from this worktree (run `npm ci` first). Do not weaken existing tests. Commit on this branch only.
